subject: general
question: Which cultural festival of India is a ten-day festival of classical dance, folk art and light music, and is held every year between February and March at Shilpgram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taj Mahotsav**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taj Mahotsav** is a ten-day cultural festival of India celebrated at Shilpgram.
 
• The festival takes place every year between February and March.
 
• It showcases classical dance, folk art, and light music, attracting artists and performers from across the country.
 
• The event is organized by the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Department and aims to promote the rich cultural heritage of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shilpgram** is a crafts village located near the Taj Mahal in Agra, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The festival not only highlights traditional arts and crafts but also includes a vibrant display of cuisine, carnival rides, and various other forms of entertainment.
 
• The Taj Mahotsav is a significant event for artisans and craftsmen, providing them with a platform to showcase and sell their work.
 
• The festival was first held in 1992 and has since become an annual feature, drawing both domestic and international tourists.
